name: Chapel
text: A small ruined chapel sits underground.

pass.text: You find a small offering of a pile of coins.

fail.text: All the candles suddenly go out and you flee the room in terror.

name: Crypt
text: Rows of stone coffins line the walls of this room.

pass.text: You find a small offering of gold.

fail.text: One of the coffins begins to open. You run.

name: Dining Hall
text: A long cracked wooden table sits in the middle of the room. Every chair is empty.

pass.text: You find gold beneath one of the plates

fail.text: One of the chairs slowly pulls itself away from the table as you exit the room.

name: Garden
text: Plants grow beneath the stone ceiling, despite the complete lack of sunlight.

pass.text: You find a small silver dagger among the roots.

fail.text: A vine moves to wrap around your foot as you flee.
